comments.body: Considering Argon was already better than Opus and Game coding yes, Carbon is better

replies.author: Prior-Meeting1645
replies.body: In what aspect exactly did u find argon to be better than O5.5?😳 I have visuals mostly in mind, but tbh O5.5 is almost unanimously agreed to be the best model in basically everything too. Till the fable/carbon drops at least

replies.author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
replies.body: 3D animation in blender. Argon has physical common sense that Opus and ChatGPT just don't have.

replies.author: NicNacksTheSixSnax
replies.body: Would you say Carbon is even better than Argon? Or not worth it?

replies.author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
replies.body:
I also had Argon map all the physics in my 3D sports game and it was able to hone in the 3D physics far better than Opus. 

Opus is a great coder, don't get me wrong, it lacks physical sense. Rig a human body in Mixamo skeleton and ask Opus to make it do jumping jacks, then have Argon do it. The difference is palpable

replies.body: Is Argon good with these tasks? Have you compared it with the new Fable 5.2?
